+# frozen_string_literal: true
+# Rails 8.1.4 response charset inheritance, shared by Ruby, JRuby and Spinel.
+module ActionController
+  class Base
+    def render(body, status: :ok, content_type: nil, location: nil)
+      @_body = body
+      @_status = resolve_status(status)
+      @_performed = true
+      unless content_type.nil?
+        incoming = render_content_type_parts(head_option_content_type(content_type))
+        previous = render_content_type_parts(@_content_type.to_s)
+        charset = incoming[1].to_s
+        charset = previous[1].to_s if charset.empty?
+        charset = "utf-8" if charset.empty?
+        @_content_type = incoming[0].to_s
+        unless @_content_type.empty?
+          @_content_type = @_content_type + "; charset=" + charset.downcase
+        end
+      end
+      @_location = ActionController.sanitize_location(location) unless location.nil?
+      apply_vary_header
+      nil
+    end
+
+    # ActionDispatch::Response::CONTENT_TYPE_PARSER, with numbered captures
+    # for Spinel's MatchData API. Keep Rails' quoting and case semantics.
+    def render_content_type_parts(value)
+      match = value.match(/\A([^;\s]+\s*(?:;\s*(?:(?!charset)[^;\s])+)*)?(?:;\s*charset=("?)([^;\s]+)\2)?/)
+      return ["", ""] if match.nil?
+      [match[1].to_s, match[3].to_s]
+    end
+  end
+end

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+class ContentProbesController < ActionController::API
+  def json
+    render json: { ok: true }
+  end
+  def plain
+    render plain: "ok"
+  end
+  def html
+    render html: "ok"
+  end
+  def vendor_json
+    render json: { ok: true }, content_type: "application/vnd.api+json"
+  end
+  def json_charset
+    render json: { ok: true }, content_type: "application/json; charset=iso-8859-1"
+  end
+  def head_ok
+    head :ok
+  end
+  def head_csv
+    head :ok, content_type: "text/csv"
+  end
+  def send_csv
+    send_data "ok", type: "text/csv"
+  end
+  def send_binary
+    send_data "ok", type: "application/octet-stream"
+  end
+  def redirect
+    redirect_to "/target"
+  end
+  def plain_csv
+    render plain: "ok", content_type: "text/csv"
+  end
+  def plain_charset
+    render plain: "ok", content_type: "text/plain; charset=iso-8859-1"
+  end
+  def head_json
+    head :ok, content_type: "application/json"
+  end
+  def head_no_content
+    head :no_content
+  end
+  def send_json
+    send_data "ok", type: "application/json"
+  end
+  def inherited_charset
+    self.content_type = "text/html; charset=iso-8859-1"
+    render plain: "ok", content_type: "text/csv"
+  end
+  def new_symbol_type
+    render plain: "ok", content_type: :csv

+require "rack/mock"
+require "json"
+require_relative "controller"
+rows = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(__dir__, "expected.json"))).map do |name, _status, _type|
+  action = name == "head" ? "head_ok" : name
+  status, headers, body = ContentProbesController.action(action).call(Rack::MockRequest.env_for("http://example.org/" + name))
+  body.close if body.respond_to?(:close)
+  [name, status, headers["content-type"]]
+end
+puts JSON.generate(rows)
